title: Cloud runs' status model reads their records under the factory run id, but the container writes them under epic-<epic-id>
body: cloudStatusModel/statusRecords open the run-state store with RunID = the factory's run_<hex>, yet a cloud run's orchestrator container runs ticfac run-epic <epic>, whose records land on the integration branch under .ticfac/runs/epic-<epic-id>/. So a real cloud run's model reads empty records: attempts, findings, evidence, checkpoint and cost degrade to feed-and-graph only, the live frame never shows waves from records, and a hold on untriaged findings surfaces only through the feed's run_held line, never as the model's WaitFinding attention with its triage pointer. Local runs are unaffected (their runID is epic-<epic-id> by construction).
